This matrix is the Beta companion to the scope contract. It distinguishes implemented code, tested behavior, installed artifact journeys, and external release evidence. A green automated test is not an independent review, a real-provider quality result, or a release decision.

The following are intentionally not inferred from repository tests:

RequirementOwner/issueRequired recordCurrent boundary

Independent Beta boundary security review#851Threat model, attack evidence, independent findings and rerun resultsRequired for #613; self-review and Copilot do not satisfy independence.

Bounded real-provider quality evidence#613 / #608Authorized held-out corpus, provider/version, thresholds, spend cap and abort ruleSynthetic CI does not satisfy this requirement.
Consolidated Beta acceptance report and release decision#613docs/reports/egi/D5-acceptance.md on one exact candidate SHAThe control remains open until all B01–B16 evidence and external gates are recorded.

How to read status#

  • Implemented means the code exists on the candidate branch or main after its PR merge.
  • Automated means a named deterministic test is collected and passed; a skipped job is not a pass.
  • Installed means the SDK/CLI artifact or UI journey was built from the candidate SHA and exercised.
  • Externally evidenced means the required independent reviewer, domain owner or real-provider protocol supplied a dated record. It cannot be created by this matrix.
  • Ready for release is only the decision recorded by #613 after the complete candidate matrix, not a label this page assigns to a partial implementation.

The intervention guide gives the operator steps for the run-scoped journey. The architecture reader guide links the Beta control spine to the deeper subsystem contracts.
